content: Click an agent's name to open its chat. Use Pin to top for the ones you use daily, and use the three dots to change the setup, invite people, or duplicate it for a similar job.

comment.text: Body of the AI Agents onboarding tour step that highlights the first agent row in the list; admin variant (non-admins see AgentRowMember). Pin to top is a context-menu action name; the three dots are the row's menu button.

usage.context:
// 4. An agent row; a user gets other wording.
 hasItems &&
 fileItemStep(
 FIRST_ITEM_SELECTOR,
 t("AiAgentsTour:AgentRowTitle"),
 isAdmin ? t("AiAgentsTour:AgentRow") : t("AiAgentsTour:AgentRowMember"),
 callbacks,
 AI_AGENTS_TOUR_LABEL,
 leaveAgent,
 ),
